_canary.note: Retention/Object-Lock administrator. Separate principal, off the application VDS, NOT used by the ordinary backup/restore/app flow. Active candidate = read versioning/Object-Lock config + PutObjectRetention on the canary prefix only. The provisional_actions (DeleteObjectVersion / BypassGovernanceRetention / lifecycle / legal-hold) are PROVISIONAL — they are NOT in the active Allow statements, are NOT applied by ordinary CI, and require Inal approval + live 3C2C before use. Compliance mode and legal hold are never activated here.
